title: 第19章 你要是被劈死我就成寡奴了第20章 中坛元帅也太好打发了吧
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 孙悟空扯下玄色裤衩，脸上瞧不出是恼还是没恼。
江盼被他牢牢圈在怀里，指尖揪着他衣摆直发抖，心跳如擂鼓，眼眶一红，顿时带了哭音：“对不起……我真不是故意的！”
“这、这裤衩……本来就是想送给您的，就是刚才没来得及……”
话还没说完，她余光瞥见哪吒——对方整张脸黑如锅底，眼中杀意汹涌，明明白白写着“你完了”
三个大字。
江盼心头一咯噔，赶紧偷偷传音：【哪吒大人！
我回去一定解释，你别生气好不好？】
她想两头都不得罪，索性顺着话头呜呜哭出来：“其实我是嫌天宫月钱太少、规矩又多，才偷偷溜下界的！”
“老神仙说……用玄色丝绸裤衩套头能保一辈子好运。”
“我看大王您明明没做错什么，玉帝却偏要抓您，我一着急，就想给您添点运气……”
“蠢鱼！
哪吒指节捏得泛白，火尖枪尖窜出噼里啪啦的火星。
上次这蠢鱼也是同一套说辞，说什么偷裤衩是为了给他招运，现在居然原封不动转送这死猴子！
江盼忙不迭又传音，软绵绵地哄：【哪吒大人，我最喜欢的还是你！
回去肯定跟你说清楚，你别凶嘛～】
哪吒冷哼一声，传回来的话音依旧戾气十足：【回去要是说不明白，你知道什么下场。
孙悟空低头瞧着怀里哭得梨花带雨的小姑娘，抬手用裤衩边蹭掉她的眼泪。
他俯身凑近她耳畔，声音压得极低，只有两人听得清：“小骗子，你跟哪吒传音的话，我可全都听见了哦。”
江盼浑身一僵，还没来得及消化孙悟空的这句话，系统突然在脑内疯狂炸响：【滴滴滴！
检测到宿主未按时完成任务，惩罚：天雷即将劈下！
江盼彻底慌了:【这破系统真要命！
现在怎么办啊？！
她攥着孙悟空衣摆的指尖收得更紧，眼睛慌乱地扫视洞府，想找个能躲雷的地方。
【系统:天雷可转移至他人身上，转移条件是与宿主有直接或间接接触。
倒计时一分钟:六十、五十九、五十八……】
孙悟空察觉她指尖发颤、眼神乱瞟，手臂在她腰上又紧了紧，金瞳里漾开戏谑的笑意：“乱动什么？知道怕了？”
江盼心里一横，瞬间往他怀里钻得更深，双臂死死环住他脖子，声音软得发颤：“没、没怕！
就是觉得……抱着大王特别有安全感。”
【呸呸呸！
什么安全感，是你自己主动抱我的！
content_en:
Sun Wukong pulled off his black pants, and it was unclear whether he was annoyed or not.
Jiang Pan was tightly held in his arms, holding the hem of his clothes with her fingertips and shaking, her heart beating like a drum, her eyes turned red, and she suddenly started crying: "I'm sorry... I really didn't mean it!"
"These, these pants... I originally wanted to give them to you, but I just didn't have time..."
Before she finished speaking, she caught a glimpse of Nezha from the corner of her eye - his entire face was as black as the bottom of a pot, and murderous intent surged in his eyes, which clearly read "You're finished."
Three big characters.
Jiang Pan's heart skipped a beat and he quickly sent a message secretly: [Lord Nezha!
I'll make sure to explain when I get back, please don't be angry, okay? 】
She wanted to avoid offending both parties, so she simply cried along with the words: "Actually, I felt that the monthly payment in Tiangong was too small and there were too many rules, so I sneaked down to the lower world!"
"The old god said... Wearing black silk pants over your head can ensure a lifetime of good luck."
"I see that your Majesty has done nothing wrong, but the Jade Emperor insists on arresting you. When I am anxious, I want to give you some luck..."
“Stupid fish!
You-"
Nezha's knuckles turned white when he pinched them, and sparks popped out from the tip of the fire.
This stupid fish used the same rhetoric last time, saying that he stole his underwear to bring him luck, but now he actually passed it on to this damn monkey intact!
Jiang Pan was busy and sent another message, coaxing softly: [Master Nezha, you are still my favorite!
I’ll make it clear to you when I get back, don’t be mean~]
Nezha snorted coldly, and the voice that came back was still full of anger: [If you don't understand when you go back, you know what will happen.
Sun Wukong looked down at the little girl crying in his arms, and raised his hand to wipe away her tears with the edge of his pants.
He leaned close to her ear and lowered his voice so low that only the two of them could hear clearly: "Little liar, I heard everything you said to Nezha."
Jiang Pan froze, and before he had time to digest Sun Wukong's words, the system suddenly exploded crazily in his head: [Didi!
It is detected that the host has not completed the task on time, and the punishment: thunder is about to strike!
Jiang Pan was completely panicked: [This broken system is really terrible!
What to do now? !
She tightened her fingertips on the hem of Sun Wukong's clothes, and her eyes frantically scanned the cave, trying to find a place to hide from the thunder.
[System: Tianlei can be transferred to others. The transfer condition is direct or indirect contact with the host.
One minute countdown: sixty, fifty-nine, fifty-eight...]
Sun Wukong noticed that her fingertips were trembling and her eyes were wandering. His arms tightened around her waist, and a playful smile appeared in his golden eyes: "Why are you moving? Are you scared?"
Jiang Pan's heart skipped a beat, and he immediately dug deeper into his arms, wrapping his arms tightly around his neck, and his voice was so soft that it trembled: "No, I'm not afraid!
I just feel that... I feel very safe holding the king in my arms. "
[Bah, bah, bah!
What kind of sense of security is that you took the initiative to hug me!
title_en: Chapter 19 If you are hacked to death, I will become a widowed slave. Chapter 20 Marshal Zhongtan is too easy to dismiss.
